Services

What a notary does

The notary acts where the law requires notarial form or where the parties want legal certainty. He advises all sides equally and may not favour anyone.

Real estate

Purchase agreement, land charge, transfer, condominium ownership, leasehold.

To the page

Inheritance

Will, inheritance contract, certificate of inheritance, disclaimer, waiver of compulsory portion.

To the page

Gifts

Transfer agreement, anticipated succession, right of residence, usufruct.

To the page

Powers of attorney

Lasting power of attorney, living will, guardianship directive, central register.

To the page

Family

Marriage contract, divorce settlement, adoption, paternity, maintenance.

To the page

Companies

GmbH and UG, share transfers, amendments, commercial register, restructuring.

To the page

Certifications and Switzerland

Certified signature, certified copy, apostille, documents for abroad.

To the page

Prepare your appointment. There is a questionnaire for every service, in English. On screen or on paper, encrypted to the office.

Also in disputes. The notary can act as a neutral body in disagreements, for example among heirs or shareholders. An agreement before the notary is usually faster than court proceedings and can be made enforceable.
